name: Naiad (Legendary Games)
body:
The base racial traits for naiads are described here. Here are some new racial traits and options.

Alternate Racial Traits
Artistic Beauty: A naiad with muse blood counts Craft and Perform as single skills and all Knowledge skills as class skills. This racial trait replaces fey nature.
Child of Celestial Seas: Naiads whose nymph ancestors intermingled with tritons are considered native outsiders in addition to fey and are treated as tritons for all prerequisites. This ability alters the naiad’s type and subtype.
Darkvision: A naiad with this racial trait has darkvision to 60 feet. This replaces fey nature.
Fey Lure: Once per day, a naiad with this racial trait can fascinate one creature within 20 feet of her with song, offering it a vision of the thing it desires the most. A fascinated creature can do nothing but moving towards the naiad for a number of rounds equal to 1/2 her character level (minimum 1). Targets may resist with a Will save (DC 10 + 1/2 the naiad’s level + the naiad’s Charisma modifier). This is a supernatural ability. This racial trait replaces inspiration.
Human Heritage: Naiads with a strong bond to their mortal ancestors count as humanoid (human) as well as fey (water) for all purposes (such as humanoid-affecting spells such as charm person or enlarge person). They do not automatically gain Sylvan as a language (but may select it as a bonus language if their Intelligence is high enough). This ability alters the naiad’s type, subtype, and languages.
Know Heart’s Desire: A naiad with this racial trait can cast detect desires three times per day as a spell-like ability. This replaces water bond.
Sea Seer: Some naiads have more affinity for salt water than fresh water. These characters cast abjuration and divination spells as if they were one level higher when within 1,000 feet from the sea. This racial trait replaces water bond.
Sea Voice: A naiad related to selkies can instinctively alter the intonation of her voice to make anything she says sound more pleasing to those who understand it. When using the Bluff skill, she treats her lies as one step more believable for the purposes of bonuses or penalties on the check. This racial trait replaces fey nature.
Speeding Wave: Some naiads descended from oceanids can use slipstream as a spell-like ability once per day. This racial trait replaces water bond.
Unearthly Grace: A naiad with this racial trait adds her Charisma modifier as a racial bonus on all her saving throws, and as a deflection bonus to her Armor Class, in place of her Dexterity bonus. This replaces inspiration.
Water Veil: Naiads descended from the extraplanar nymphs known as veelas can treat any one melee weapon they wield as a frost weapon, twice per day for a duration of 1 minute. This racial trait replaces water bond.
Water Witch: A naiad with strong bonds with the water element has a +2 racial bonus on Knowledge (planes) and Swim. This racial trait replaces fey nature.
Wild Empathy: Naiads more near to the woods than to water have the wild empathy ability like druids of the same level. This racial trait replaces water bond.
Favored Class Bonuses
Bard: Treat the bard’s level as +1/2 level higher for the purpose of determining the effect of the fascinate bardic performance.
Druid: Add a +1 bonus on wild empathy checks to influence animals and magical beasts with the aquatic, fey or water subtype.
Inquisitor: Add +1/2 on Diplomacy, Intimidate, and Sense Motive checks made against creatures with the aquatic or water subtype.
Kineticist: Add 1/4 to the save DC of the kineticist’s water infusions and wild talents.
Magus: Gain 1/6 of one of the following magus arcana: aquatic agility, arcing pool strike, clinging pool strike, pool ray, pool strike, wave stepDD. If the magus has access to witch hexes, she can also select the following hexes: pollute water, sink, water lung.
Occultist: The naiad can use one of her tokens or an object containing a token as an implement for any arcane school she knows +1/day.
Oracle: An oracle with the waves mystery adds one spell from the druid’s spell list to the oracle’s spell list. This spell must be at least 1 level lower than the highest spell level the oracle can cast.
Rogue: Add +1/3 to the rogue’s bonus on either armor class or saving throws while using her water bond racial ability.
Sorcerer: Choose a bloodline power from the aquatic or fey bloodline that the sorcerer can use. The sorcerer treats her class level as though it were 1/6 higher (to a maximum of +2) when determining the effects of that power.
Witch: Add one spell from the sorcerer/wizard spell list that isn’t on the witch spell list to the list of spells the witch knows. This spell must be at least 1 level below the highest spell level the witch can cast and have the water descriptor.
Naiad Character Traits
Fey Summoner (Race Trait)

Prerequisite(s): Naiad

You find easy calling your fey relatives to help. Whenever you cast a summon monster or summon nature’s ally spell, you add all fey creatures from both lists to the list of monsters you can summon, plus the ones in the First WorlderISM summoner’s list.

Hydromancer (Race Trait)

Prerequisite(s): Naiad

Your native element reinforces your supernatural perceptions.

When you use a body of water, a water-filled container, or a mirror as an additional focus to cast a divination spell, your caster level is increased by 1. If the target of your spell carries your token, the caster level is increased by 2.

Token Magic (Magic Trait)

Prerequisite(s): Naiad, inspiration racial trait

Your innate eldritch affinity fuels your magic abilities. You can use your token or an object incorporating your token as a bonded item, holy symbol, or occultist’s implement, even if it is not the type of object normally used for that purpose. When using your token item to cast a spell from your specialization school or domain, or from the occultist implement school it is tied to, you can add +1 to the spell’s DC.

Naiad Feats
Craft Token Items (Item Creation, Monster Feat)

You can inspire your chosen ones through magical items you create for them.

Prerequisite(s): Craft Magic Arms and Armor, Craft Wondrous Items, or Forge Ring; inspiration racial ability.

Benefit(s): When you craft a magic weapon, armor, shield, ring, or wondrous item, you may incorporate your token in it as part of the item crafting process. This increases the item’s price by 1,000 gp for every HD you possess. The creature receiving the item gains the permanent benefits of your inspiration ability and does not count for the purpose of your limit of inspired creatures. The creature also gets a luck bonus on its AC equal to 1/2 your Charisma bonus (if your Charisma bonus layer changes, the bonus granted by a token item remains the same). If the token item is an armor, the wielder adds this bonus to the item’s existing AC bonus (up to a maximum of 5). If it is a weapon, the wielder adds the bonus to the weapon’s existing attack bonus instead (up to a maximum of 5). If the token item can be worn or wielded, its possessor must do so in order to receive its benefits.

Improved Inspiration (Monster Feat)

You forged a special bond with one inspired creature.

Prerequisite(s): Inspiration racial ability, 8th level.

Benefit(s): Choose one of your inspired creatures. That creature doubles the bonuses granted by your inspiration ability and gains a status effect on you as well.

Greater Inspiration (Monster Feat)

Your bond with one inspired creature becomes exceptionally strong.

Prerequisite(s): Improved Inspiration, inspiration racial ability, 12th level.

Benefit(s): You add your Charisma bonus to the number of creatures you can inspire at the same time. In addition, your link with the creature you selected with Improved Inspiration improves, as if you had cast greater status on that creature.
